spell.name: Antagonize

components.m: a playing card depicting a rogue

entries: You whisper magical words that antagonize one creature of your choice within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 4d4} psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of your choice that you can see. If the target can't make this attack (for example, because there is no one within its reach or because its reaction is unavailable), the target instead has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d4|3-9|1d4} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Assisted Aim
entries: You invigorate up to three creatures, including yourself, within range with improved accuracy. Each target gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls it makes with Ranged weapons. Additionally, the normal and long range of Ranged weapons wielded by a target are doubled for the spell's duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: At Your Side
entries: You and up to three other willing creatures of your choice within range form an arcane bond, which magically pulls you towards each other when moving in a forward direction. For the duration, each target's speed increases by 5 feet, and whenever an affected creature ends its turn, other targets of the spell can use their reaction to move up to half their speed in the direction of another affected creature.

When you cast this spell, choose one target, which can be yourself, to take the lead. This will be the person that the spell pulls the others towards when moving. It takes a bonus action from the person choosen as the lead to select a different target, affected by this spell, to take point without needing to recast the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Call of the Wild

components.m: a bit of animal fur or hide

entries: You unleash a primal howl that calls lesser creatures to your command. Each Beast within 100 feet of you is now {@condition charmed} by you. Each beast must make a Wisdom saving throw to determine the duration and additional effects of the {@condition Charmed} condition. On a failed save, the {@condition Charmed} condition lasts for the duration of the spell and the target understand your commands, following them to the best of its ability until you issue them a new command, which takes a bonus action on your subsequent turns. On a successful save, the {@condition charmed} condition lasts until the start of your next turn, but you have no additional ability to command it. The howl is audible within 300 feet.

spell.name: Cat's Spring
entries: You jump up to 10 feet towards another creature, to an unoccupied space you can see, and deliver a spectral claw attack. Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Force Damage and the next attack roll you make against it before the end of your next turn has advantage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

spell.name: Clue
entries: When you cast this spell, all footprints and fingerprints within a 30-foot emanation originating from you become highlighted and glow faintly for the duration.

When you cast the spell, choose any point in time up to 10 days ago. Only footprints and fingerprints left between that time and the present will be highlighted. Each creature that leaves footprints and fingerprints is assigned a unique color, but are not otherwise identified.
Any creature that moves or touches objects within the emanation will also leave colorful footprints and fingerprints, which might reveal {@condition invisible} creatures in the area.

spell.name: Conjure Cover
entries: You conjure a low cobblestone wall along the ground at a point you can see within range. The wall is 18 inches thick and is composed of three 5-foot-long, 3-foot-high segments. Each segment must be contiguous with at least one other segment.

A Medium creature that hunkers behind the wall has {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} to {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}. A Small creature that hunkers behind it has {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover} to {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}. The wall can be leapt over following standard {@book jump rules|phb|8|Jumping}, with the discretion of your DM.

Each segment has AC 10 and 30 hit points. Reducing a segment of the wall to 0 hit points causes it to crumble, destroying it. The wall disappears when all the segments are destroyed or the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When casting this spell using a 2nd level spell slot or higher, you can choose between either adding one additional wall segment per spell slot level above 1, or increasing each segments' hit points by 5 per spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Dark Path
entries: You conjure a shadowy road between two points, with at least one point within range, to create a bridge or path. This effect can bridge a chasm or create a smooth path through {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. The dark path is 10 feet wide and up to 50 feet long. It can support up to 500 pounds of weight at one time. A creature that adds more weight than what the path can support will fall through the path as if it were an illusion.

spell.name: Dazing Blast
entries: A wave of force leaves your palms, targeting a creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d6} Force damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a 3rd level spell slot or higher, you can target one additional creature for each spell slot above 2.

spell.name: Delay
entries: You briefly slow time for a creature of your choice that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be moved to last place in the initiative order from the start of the next round onwards.

spell.name: Douse Light
entries: With a simple gesture, you can put out a single small source of light within range. This spell extinguishes a torch, a candle, a lantern, or a single source from the {@spell Dancing Lights} cantrip, excluding its singular medium humanoid form.

spell.name: Feline Chaos
entries: You summon a protective swarm of cats in a 15-foot radius sphere, centered on a point within range. Each target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration. An affected target takes {@damage 4d6} Slashing damage at the start of each of their turns, and they have Disadvantage on all ability checks and attack rolls. If they attempt to move, they must make a Constitution saving throw or gain the {@condition Prone} condition, taking another {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage from the startled cats. At the end of their turn an affected creature makes another Dexterity saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage at the start of an affected target's turns increases by {@dice 2d6} for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Gift
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range. You take {@damage 1d20} necrotic damage, and the target regains hit points equal to the amount of damage you took.

spell.name: Hangover
entries: You target one creature within range to become enveloped by an illusory drunken aura that quickly washes away, leaving an intense mental hangover. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 3d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Poisoned} condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. The target has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws it makes to maintain {@status Concentration} as a result of this damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Hibernation
entries: You hum a soothing melody and discard a bit of bear fur, which induces a soporific healing state in the next creature you touch. The target regains {@dice 2d6} plus your spellcasting modifier in hit points and is in a state of {@condition unconscious} rest for the duration of the spell. If the creature is unwilling, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or is {@condition charmed} and impacted by this spell.

The spell ends early if the hibernating creature takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap the hibernating creature awake. Undead and creatures immune to being {@condition charmed} aren't affected by this spell, however, those who enter a meditative restful state as their long rest, such as elves, can be affected by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If cast using 3rd-level or higher spell slot, you may touch one additional willing creature per level to induce hibernation.

spell.name: Holy Word
entries: You whisper a divine word under your breath, making a ranged spell attack against a target within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Radiant damage. If the target is Fey, Fiend, or Undead, its speed is reduced by 10 feet and it can't take reactions until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

spell.name: Incite Riot
entries: When you cast this spell, you call the masses to your attention and choose any number of creatures within range that can see you. Each chosen creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. Targets have Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Charmed} condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The {@condition Charmed} creature is Friendly to you and your allies. While {@condition Charmed}, it must use its action to make melee attacks against the nearest creature (other than you or your allies) or use its turn to move toward the nearest target.

spell.name: Jethro's Instant Reload
entries: You touch one ranged weapon with the {@itemProperty LD|PHB|Loading} or {@itemProperty RLD|DMG|Reload} property. It becomes enchanted and reload itself automatically, ignoring the {@itemProperty LD|PHB|Loading} or {@itemProperty RLD|DMG|Reload} property for the duration. When the weapon's ammunition is depleted, ammunition you are carrying teleports into the weapon. All damage dealt by the enhanted weapon is considered magical.
The spell ends early when you expend all of your ammunition.

spell.name: Nature Storm
entries: You create a chaotic cloud of any flying insects, swirling leaves, or something similar of your choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The area is {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}, and any resting smoke or fog in the area is dispersed.

Creatures of your choice will either be affected or not affected by the spell's effects (your choice). For the duration, the affected area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. When a creature attempts to leave the spell's area, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled back to an unoccupied space closest to the center of the sphere.

spell.name: Obfuscate Object
entries: While you are in dim light, you cause an object in range to become unobtrusively obscured from the sight of other creatures. For the duration, you have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) checks to hide the object. The object can't be larger than a shortsword, and it must be on your person, held in your hand, or otherwise unattended.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: When you cast this spell, you can affect two objects when you reach 5th level, three objects at 11th level, and four objects at 17th level.

spell.name: Phoenix Flames
entries: You immolate yourself, consuming your body in a searing cloud of holy flames. You are reduced to 0 Hit Points and die, and burning radiance erupts from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 30d6} Radiant damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion} level. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, it and everything nonmagical it is wearing and carrying are incinerated. The target can be revived only by a {@spell True Resurrection} or a {@spell Wish} spell.
After 10 minutes, you rise from the ashes where you originally cast the spell. You return to life as if you were targeted by a {@spell True Resurrection} spell.

spell.name: Primordial Power
entries: When you cast this spell, you grant a creature in range a portion of the power of the elementals. For the duration, the creature can speak and understand Primordial and gains additional benefits based on the element you choose when you cast the spell:

items.name: Air
entries: The target has Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage. In addition, it has a Fly Speed of 30 feet.

items.name: Coldfire
entries: The target has Resistance to Cold damage. In addition, it can use a Bonus Action to expend a Hit Point Dice, regaining a number of Hit Points equal to the numbered rolled plus its Constitution modifier. When the target takes Fire damage, it can't use this Bonus Action on its next turn.

items.name: Earth
entries: The target has Advantage on saving throws against being moved or knocked {@condition Prone}. In addition, it has {@sense tremorsense|MM} with a range of 30 feet.

items.name: Fire
entries: The target has Resistance to Fire damage. In addition, when the target takes damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of it, it can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an {@action Unarmed Attack|PHB|Unarmed Strike Attack}.

items.name: Water
entries: The target has resistance to Acid damage. In addition, it can breathe underwater and has a swim speed of 60 feet.

spell.name: Resilient Friendship
entries: You magically assist a creature within range, granting it the benefits of the {@action Help} action. If the target you helped successfully accomplishes the task by the start of your next turn, you gain {@dice 1d4} temporary hit points, which last for 1 hour.
These temporary hit points do not stack with subsequent castings of this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The number of temporary hit points you gain increases when you reach 5th level ({@dice 1d6}), 11th level ({@dice 1d8}), and 17th level ({@dice 1d10}).

spell.name: Retrieve
entries: You cause an object within range that isn't being worn or carried to instantly fly to your open hand. The object must weigh no more than 10 pounds or the spell fails.

spell.name: Ride the Lightning
entries: You transform yourself into a bolt of lightning, creating a 5-foot-wide line between your current space and an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. You then reappear in the chosen space.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 4. In addition, the maximum length of the line increases 10 feet for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Rumor
entries: You magically spread a rumor of 10 words or less in a 60-foot Emanation originating from you. Any creature within the Emanation that can hear and understand three or more other nearby creatures believes that they hear the rumor being repeated by someone nearby. Different creatures hear the rumor from different people, so a concrete origin is impossible to discern. Generally, creatures won't become Hostile upon hearing even the most vicious rumors, but hearing a rumor can affect their attitude positively or negatively.
When the spell ends, there is a chance the rumor still spreads, without the aid of magical influence.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 4th level spell slot, the emanation range increases to 80 feet. When you cast this spell using a 7th level spell slot, the emanation range increases to 100 feet.

spell.name: Shadow Puppets
entries: You animate the shadow of a creature within range, causing it to attack that creature. As part of the bonus action to cast this spell, as well as a bonus action on subsequent rounds while the spell is active, you can make a melee spell attack against the creature, using its own shadow. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} Psychic damage and must make a successful Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Spell Signature
entries: As you cast the spell you draw out the potent scents trapped within all magic. Choose a magical effect you are aware of that's within range. The effect releases a scent specific to the creature that created it. If you are familiar with the creature, based on any step in the list below, you automatically know that information.

If you are not familiar with the creature, you can make an {@skill Arcana} or {@skill History} check (your choice) using your Spellcasting Ability, adding your proficiency bonus if you are proficient in the skill. Refer to the table below to determine what information you are able to glean from the scent. When succeeding on a DC check, you also learn previous information given from lower DCs.

items: DC 5—You learn the type of creature that created the magical effect.
DC 10—If the creature has a class, you learn what it is.
DC 15—You learn if the creature is affiliated with an organization.
DC 20—You learn the name of the creature.

spell.name: Spirit of Death

m.text: a gilded playing card worth at least 400 gp and depicting an avatar of death

entries: You call forth a spirit that embodies death. The spirit manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range and uses the {@creature reaper spirit|BMT} stat block. The spirit disappears when it is reduced to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The spirit is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the spirit shares your initiative count and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue the spirit any commands, it takes the {@action Dodge} action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears in the reaper spirit stat block.

spell.name: Spirit Swarm
entries: You invite spirits to take their revenge upon a target. A creature you can see within range must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 8d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Frightened} condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

spell.name: Spray of Cards
entries: You spray a 15-foot cone of spectral cards. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d10} force damage and has the {@condition blinded} condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|2-9|1d10} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Summon Plant

m.text: a ceramic pot filled with herbs and fertilizer worth at least 200 GP

entries: You call forth a plant spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the {@creature Plant Spirit|BMT} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a floral feature: Blooming, Oaken, or Thorny. The creature resembles an animated plant marked by the chosen floral feature, which determines one of the traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge} action and uses its move to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

spell.name: Summon Sea Spirit

m.text: a bejeweled statuette of a sea serpent worth at least 300 GP

entries: You call forth an abyssal spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the {@creature Sea Serpent Spirit|BMT} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose an abhorrent feature: Enormous Mouth, Glowing Lantern, or Scaled Wings. The creature resembles a monstrous sea creature marked by the chosen abhorrent feature, which determines one of the traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge} action and uses its move to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

spell.name: Thorn Armor
entries: When you cast this spell, a flexible exoskeleton covered in thorns appears around a willing target within range. The target gains {@dice 3d6} Temporary Hit Points. If a creature hits the target with a melee attack roll before the spell ends, that creature takes Piercing damage equal to the number of Temporary Hit Points lost as a result of the attack. This spell ends early if the target has no remaining Temporary Hit Points granted by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The target gains an additional {@dice 2d6} Temporary Hit Points for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Transparency

time.condition: which you take when your location would be revealed to a creature while you are hidden or unseen

entries: You temporarily become {@condition invisible} to stop yourself from being discovered by the triggering creature. Until the end of your next turn, you remain {@condition invisible} and your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. Anything you are wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} as long as it is on your person. The spell ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

spell.name: Vengeful Blade

m.text: a melee weapon worth at least 1 gp

entries: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then radiates a dark aura of energy until the start of your next turn. If the target makes an attack or casts a spell before then, the target takes {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage and the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes for making an attack or casting a spell increases to {@dice 2d8}. Both damage rolls increase by {@dice 1d8} at 11th level ({@dice 2d8} and {@dice 3d8}) and again at 17th level ({@dice 3d8} and {@dice 4d8}).

spell.name: Whelm Weapon
entries: Up to three weapons of your choice that you can see within range become enveloped by water. Roll a {@dice d4}; for the duration, any damage dealt by the targeted weapons is reduced by the number you rolled (to a minimum of 1).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target two additional weapons for each slot level above 1st.
